name: Loss of command authority
description: The operator can no longer be sure it is the only party commanding the asset.

name: Loss of confidentiality
description: Mission, user or design information is exposed to an unauthorised party.

name: Loss of data integrity
description: Data, parameters or products are altered and may be trusted wrongly.

name: Service outage
description: The mission service is unavailable to some or all users.

name: Service degradation
description: The service continues with reduced capacity, accuracy or timeliness.

name: Loss of health visibility
description: The operator cannot see, or cannot trust, the true state of the spacecraft.

name: Loss of navigation and timing trust
description: Position or time delivered to users or used by the system is wrong or unavailable.

name: Recoverable asset degradation
description: Consumables, lifetime or performance are spent but the asset can be recovered.

name: Permanent asset loss
description: A spacecraft, terminal fleet or ground capability is lost beyond recovery.

name: Safety and collision risk
description: Risk to people, to other spacecraft or to the orbital environment.

name: Downstream cascade
description: Customers and dependent sectors lose a service they rely on.

name: Loss of assurance
description: The operator cannot prove the system is in a trusted state, even if it works.
